title: Appointed as Assistant
original: Doctor, these are your tasks for the day. Yeah. A whole pile of work. Let's get to it.

title: Talk 1
original: Is Ifrit making trouble again? Sorry. I'll discipline her later.

title: Talk 2
original: Zzzzz… Sorry, I was taking a nap… I'm still not used to working during the day.

title: Talk 3
original: My reasons for quitting Rhine Lab? So much happened since I signed on, I don't even know where to start…

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: Have you ever heard of a woman named Saria? Like me, she was once a scientist at Rhine Lab, and she was one of the people responsible for the creation of Ifrit…

title: Talk after Promotion 2
original: Our biology research at Rhine Lab went so far as to implant Originium Shards into living bodies… Sorry, we'd better change the subject.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: Saria? You mean she's here at Rhodes Island too? Is she here for Ifrit…? After she walked out on us like that, why would she come here right now…?!

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: I will not allow Ifrit to see Saria. Please trust me, this is for Ifrit's own good…!

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: Are you trying to cure Oripathy too? I heard that you were involved in the development of medical technology at Rhodes Island. Heheh… you must be looking forward to a breakthrough, as a researcher yourself.

title: Idle
original: …Asleep already? All right. I'll handle the rest of the work.

title: Onboard
original: I am Olivia Silence, an Originium scientist from the Rhine Lab Medical Research Institute. My hope is to rid the world of Oripathy… even if it means risking my life in the process.

title: Watching Battle Record
original: I will make good use of this new power.

title: Promotion 1
original: Is my medicine effective? Wonderful. This news brings me even greater joy than my promotion.

title: Promotion 2
original: Doctor, I am looking forward to the day when the world is finally cured of Oripathy. In fighting and studying with you, I think that day may not be far off.

title: Added to Squad
original: Understood. I'll focus on support.

title: Appointed as Squad Leader
original: Come on, team, let's fight with all our might.

title: Depart
original: Originium… Are you to blame for this battle?

title: Begin Operation
original: Observe and determine the form of Infection. Such data will be useful for research.

title: Selecting Operator 1
original: Doctor, let me do it.

title: Selecting Operator 2
original: No abnormality detected.

title: Deployment 1
original: Concentrate.

title: Deployment 2
original: Stay calm.

title: In Battle 1
original: I'll heal you.

title: In Battle 2
original: No need to panic.

title: In Battle 3
original: Deploying.

title: In Battle 4
original: Support incoming.

title: 4-star Result
original: In order to defeat stronger enemies, must we make further use of Originium's power…?

title: 3-star Result
original: Medical team, please take tissue samples from the Infected, we need to see the composition of the Infection in this area.

title: Sub 3-star Result
original: All wounded personnel, please remain calm. The medical team will get to you.

title: Operation Failure
original: …Now is not the time for despair. We must withdraw immediately.

title: Assigned to Facility
original: This room… Ugh… It's like it's designed to make me sleepy!

title: Tap
original: Hmm?

title: Trust Tap
original: Doctor, you're kinder these days.

title: Title
original: Arknights.

title: New Year's blessing
original: Have you seen Ifrit, Doctor? They're shooting off fireworks outside, so I'm a little worried… Yes, I'm going back to the lab after I put her to bed. No, I haven't forgotten what day it is. This is just how I want to welcome the new year. Oh right, happy New Year.

title: Greeting
original: Good day, Doctor.

title: Birthday
original: Doctor, I have a proposal for your review: a new medical drone model. Oh, and I've heard it's your birthday. I didn't mean it like this, but hopefully you find it a practical gift.

title: Anniversary Celebration
original: There's no lack of ambition and idealism in the field of life sciences… I myself was drawn by those ideals before I found my true calling. But thanks to Rhodes Island, I now know what I'm researching and fighting for.
